findings.summary:
Fix any of the following:
  Element has insufficient color contrast of 3.75 (foreground color: #ffffff, background color: #d4622f, font size: 12.0pt (16px), font weight: normal). Expected contrast ratio of 4.5:1
findings.note: The button text does not meet the minimum contrast ratio of 4.5:1, which makes it difficult for users with low vision to read the call-to-action.
findings.suggested_fix: Darken the background color to at least #b34a1b or a darker shade to achieve sufficient contrast against the white text.

findings.summary:
Fix any of the following:
  The link has insufficient color contrast of 1.47:1 with the surrounding text. (Minimum contrast is 3:1, link text: #ffffff, surrounding text: #cfd6d9)
  The link has no styling (such as underline) to distinguish it from the surrounding text
findings.note: The link is not distinguishable from surrounding text due to poor contrast and lack of visual indicators, affecting users with color vision deficiencies or low vision.
findings.suggested_fix: Add an underline to the link text and adjust the color to ensure it meets the 3:1 contrast ratio requirement against the surrounding text.
